question: The Bengal tiger was adopted as 'The national animal of India' in the year ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1972.**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The Bengal tiger was adopted as 'The national animal of India' in the year **1972.**
 
• The Bengal Tiger was declared as the national animal of India in April 1973, with the initiation of **Project Tiger.**
 
• It was a step to protect the tigers in India.
